NICODERM(R) 7 mg Step 3 patch is a medicine that can help you stop smoking by reducing withdrawal symptoms and nicotine cravings.  NICODERM(R) provides a lower level of nicotine to your blood than cigarettes, and allows you to gradually do away with your body's need for nicotine.  It works as a temporary aid to help you quit smoking by reducing nicotine cravings and nicotine withdrawal symptoms such as irritability, frustration, anxiety, difficulty concentrating and restlessness.  Without these powerful urges for the cigarettes you "need", getting rid of the "habit" cigarettes becomes much easier.

NICODERM(R) provides 24 hour rate-controlled delivery of nicotine following its application to intact skin.  NICODERM(R) reduces the withdrawal symptoms associated with smoking cessation and thus increases the success rate of smoking cessation programs.  NICODERM(R) is the only patch that has a rate controlling membrane, to give your body a steady supply of nicotine to help protect you against cravings.  Following the first NICODERM(R) application, the plasma nicotine concentration rises rapidly, plateaus within 2 to 4 hours and then slowly declines until the system is removed; after which it declines more rapidly.  Nicotine in the adhesive layer is absorbed into and through the skin, causing the initial rapid rise in plasma concentration.  The nicotine from the reservoir is released slowly through the membrane with a constant release rate.  The rate of release of nicotine from the NICODERM(R) 7 mg/24 hour patch is 0.5 mg/hr.  Following the second daily NICODERM(R) system application, steady state plasma nicotine concentration is achieved and is on average 30% higher compared with single dose applications.  The quit rate for NICODERM(R) 7 mg/day was 48%.  The unique feature offers 24-hour protection, even against the early morning cravings many people find the most difficult.

NICODERM(R) 21 mg Step 1 patch is a medicine that can help you stop smoking by reducing withdrawal symptoms and nicotine cravings.  NICODERM(R) is a form of nicotine replacement therapy (NRT) that can help double your chances of quitting successfully.  NICODERM(R) provides a lower level of nicotine to your blood than cigarettes, and allows you to gradually do away with your body's need for nicotine.  It works as a temporary aid to help you quit smoking by reducing nicotine cravings and nicotine withdrawal symptoms such as irritability, frustration, anxiety, difficulty concentrating and restlessness.  Without these powerful urges for the cigarettes you "need", getting rid of the "habit" cigarettes becomes much easier.  The good news is that NICODERM(R) contains no tar or carbon monoxide, and therefore doesn't present the same medical risks as cigarettes.

NICODERM(R) provides 24 hour rate-controlled delivery of nicotine following its application to intact skin.  NICODERM(R) reduces the withdrawal symptoms associated with smoking cessation and thus increases the success rate of smoking cessation programs.  NICODERM(R) is the only patch that has a rate controlling membrane, to give your body a steady supply of nicotine to help protect you against cravings.  Following the first NICODERM(R) application, the plasma nicotine concentration rises rapidly, plateaus within 2 to 4 hours and then slowly declines until the system is removed; after which it declines more rapidly.  Nicotine in the adhesive layer is absorbed into and through the skin, causing the initial rapid rise in plasma concentration.  The nicotine from the reservoir is released slowly through the membrane with a constant release rate.  The rate of release of nicotine from the NICODERM(R) 21 mg/24 hour patch is 1.5 mg/hr.  Following the second daily NICODERM(R) system application, steady state plasma nicotine concentration is achieved and is on average 30% higher compared with single dose applications.  The quit rate for NICODERM(R) 21 mg/day was double that of placebo (71% vs. 33%).  The unique feature offers 24-hour protection, even against the early morning cravings many people find the most difficult.

Nicotine in the adhesive layer is absorbed into and through the skin, causing the initial rapid rise in plasma concentration. The nicotine from the reservoir is released slowly through the membrane with a constant release rate. The rate of release of nicotine for NICODERM® 14mg/24hr patch is 1.0mg/hr. Following the second daily NICODERM® system application, steady state plasma nicotine concentration is achieved and is on average 30% higher compared with single dose applications. NICODERM(R) 14 mg Step 2 patch is a medicine that can help you stop smoking by reducing withdrawal symptoms and nicotine cravings.  NICODERM(R) is a form of nicotine replacement therapy (NRT) that can help double your chances of quitting successfully.  NICODERM(R) provides a lower level of nicotine to your blood than cigarettes, and allows you to gradually do away with your body's need for nicotine.  It works as a temporary aid to help you quit smoking by reducing nicotine cravings and nicotine withdrawal symptoms such as irritability, frustration, anxiety, difficulty concentrating and restlessness.  Without these powerful urges for the cigarettes you "need", getting rid of the "habit" cigarettes becomes much easier.  The good news is that NICODERM(R) contains no tar or carbon monoxide, and therefore doesn't present the same medical risks as cigarettes.

NICODERM(R) provides 24 hour rate-controlled delivery of nicotine following its application to intact skin.  NICODERM(R) reduces the withdrawal symptoms associated with smoking cessation and thus increases the success rate of smoking cessation programs.  NICODERM(R) is the only patch that has a rate controlling membrane, to give your body a steady supply of nicotine to help protect you against cravings.  Following the first NICODERM(R) application, the plasma nicotine concentration rises rapidly, plateaus within 2 to 4 hours and then slowly declines until the system is removed; after which it declines more rapidly.  Nicotine in the adhesive layer is absorbed into and through the skin, causing the initial rapid rise in plasma concentration.  The nicotine from the reservoir is released slowly through the membrane with a constant release rate.  The rate of release of nicotine from the NICODERM(R) 14 mg/24 hour patch is 1.0 mg/hr.  Following the second daily NICODERM(R) system application, steady state plasma nicotine concentration is achieved and is on average 30% higher compared with single dose applications.  The quit rate for NICODERM(R) 14 mg/day was 54%.  The unique feature offers 24-hour protection, even against the early morning cravings many people find the most difficult.

NICODERM(R) 21 mg Step 1 patch is a medicine that can help you stop smoking by reducing withdrawal symptoms and nicotine cravings.  NICODERM(R) provides a lower level of nicotine to your blood than cigarettes, and allows you to gradually do away with your body's need for nicotine.  It works as a temporary aid to help you quit smoking by reducing nicotine cravings and nicotine withdrawal symptoms such as irritability, frustration, anxiety, difficulty concentrating and restlessness.  Without these powerful urges for the cigarettes you "need", getting rid of the "habit" cigarettes becomes much easier.
NICODERM(R) provides 24 hour rate-controlled delivery of nicotine following its application to intact skin.  NICODERM(R) reduces the withdrawal symptoms associated with smoking cessation and thus increases the success rate of smoking cessation programs.  NICODERM(R) is the only patch that has a rate controlling membrane, to give your body a steady supply of nicotine to help protect you against cravings.  Following the first NICODERM(R) application, the plasma nicotine concentration rises rapidly, plateaus within 2 to 4 hours and then slowly declines until the system is removed; after which it declines more rapidly.  Nicotine in the adhesive layer is absorbed into and through the skin, causing the initial rapid rise in plasma concentration.  The nicotine from the reservoir is released slowly through the membrane with a constant release rate.  The rate of release of nicotine from the NICODERM(R) 21 mg/24 hour patch is 1.5 mg/hr.  Following the second daily NICODERM(R) system application, steady state plasma nicotine concentration is achieved and is on average 30% higher compared with single dose applications.  The quit rate for NICODERM(R) 21 mg/day was double that of placebo (71% vs. 33%).  The unique feature offers 24-hour protection, even against the early morning cravings many people find the most difficult.
